biggest_catch: Rewards are limited to a maximum of 3 payments per calendar year per individual ($225 max), and you receive nothing until your referral opens a qualifying account - Membership Savings plus checking with at least $100 in direct deposit OR an eligible loan product.
catches: Referrer must be a current MyUSA member and maintain an active account in good standing.

Friend must be a qualifying new member: open a Main Share Membership Savings Account ($5) plus a checking account with at least $100 in direct deposit OR an eligible loan product (credit cards excluded).
Friend cannot have existing accounts as primary owner, have closed an account within the past 90 days, or have been paid a promotional reward in the past 12 months.
Referral rewards limited to a maximum of 3 payments per calendar year per individual = $225 max.
$75 deposited into primary share account within 45 days of account qualification; accounts must remain open and in good standing for 90 days or MyUSA may reclaim the reward.
